mapper.select: select l.*, p.purchase_no, pr.product_name, s.supplier_name from pms_logistics l left join pms_purchase p on p.purchase_id = l.purchase_id left join pms_product pr on pr.product_id = l.product_id left join pms_supplier s on s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id where l.logistics_id = #{logisticsId}
select * from pms_logistics where logistics_no = #{logisticsNo} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pms_logistics (logistics_no, purchase_id, product_id, supplier_id, carrier_id, carrier, ship_time, arrive_time, weight_volume, freight, insurance_fee, other_fee, total_fee, pay_status, abnormal_flag, abnormal_remark, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{logisticsNo}, #{purchaseId}, #{productId}, #{supplierId}, #{carrierId}, #{carrier}, #{shipTime}, #{arriveTime}, #{weightVolume}, #{freight}, #{insuranceFee}, #{otherFee}, #{totalFee}, #{payStatus}, #{abnormalFlag}, #{abnormalRemark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update pms_logistics set pay_status = #{payStatus}, reconcile_time = #{reconcileTime}, reconcile_by = #{reconcileBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where logistics_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(freight),0) as freight, ifnull(sum(other_fee),0) as otherFee, ifnull(sum(total_fee),0) as totalFee, ifnull(sum(case when pay_status = '2' then total_fee else 0 end),0) as settledFee, ifnull(sum(case when pay_status <> '2' then total_fee else 0 end),0) as unsettledFee, count(1) as billCount from pms_logistics

select ifnull(carrier,'未填写') as name, count(1) as billCount, ifnull(sum(total_fee),0) as totalFee, ifnull(sum(freight),0) as freight from pms_logistics
group by carrier order by totalFee desc
select count(1) from pms_logistics where pay_status = #{payStatus}
select count(1) from pms_logistics where purchase_id = #{purchaseId}
